description: Answer "what is the cheapest way to track <index>?". Returns every fund tracking one index ordered cheapest fee first, deduplicated to one row per FUND rather than per venue listing (a five-venue UCITS fund is one choice, not five) with its listingCount and venues. Defaults to UCITS-buyable domiciles. Omit indexKey to list the available index families. Fees are percentage points and the response states how many funds publish no fee at all, so a "cheapest" claim is never made over silently omitted funds. Read-only.

currency.description: Keep only funds with a listing trading in this currency (e.g. CHF, EUR, USD, GBP) and name that line.

distributionPolicy.description: Optionally keep only accumulating or only distributing share classes.

exchange.description: Keep only funds listed on this venue and name each one's ticker there, e.g. SW (SIX Swiss Exchange), XETRA, LSE, AS, MI. A Swiss investor wanting the SIX line passes SW.

indexKey.description: Normalized index key, e.g. SP500, MSCI_WORLD, NASDAQ100, MSCI_EM, EURO_STOXX_50, TOPIX, FTSE100. Omit to list every index family that has at least one fund.

limit.description: Maximum funds (or index families) to return, 1-100.

scope.description: ucits (default) restricts to domiciles a European retail investor can actually buy. all adds US-domiciled trackers, which look cheaper but are not purchasable by EU retail.

name: get_etf_index_group
title: Compare funds tracking one index
